prefix.description: SEL-T401L Ultra-High-Speed Line Relay; the relay's part number is 'T401L#' followed by an SEL-assigned configuration index (e.g. T401L#0001).

part_number.note: The SEL-T401L has NO per-digit configurable Model Option Table, so there is nothing to decode. It ships in a fixed 3U horizontal rack-mount chassis; hardware selections are captured against an SEL-assigned configuration number rather than encoded into decodable part-number digits. Configurable hardware per the data sheet: power-supply range (High-Voltage 125-250 Vdc / 110-240 Vac, or Medium-Voltage 48-125 Vdc / 110-120 Vac), contact-input rated voltage (48/110/125/220/250 Vdc), 1 A vs 5 A nominal current model, and Port 5 / Port 6 SFP transceivers (ordered separately). The VER/version report lists the part number as 'T401L#xxxx' (e.g. T401L#0001); the firmware ID carries the model, e.g. SEL-T401L-Rnnn-Vx-Zsssppp-Dyyyymmdd. Order through SEL (selinc.com).
references: SEL-T401L Data Sheet (T401L_DS_20250424) - General Specifications (power supply, contact inputs, SFP transceivers); no Model Option Table printed
SEL-T401L Instruction Manual (T401L_IM_20251003) - ordering information directs to SEL; VER report Figure 9.32/9.33 shows PARTNO=T401L#xxxx

example_part_numbers.note: Sample VER-report part number from the SEL-T401L Instruction Manual (Figure 9.33). '#0001' is an SEL-assigned configuration index, not a decodable option string. That sample unit: 5 A nominal current, 125 Vdc contact inputs, 125-250 Vdc / 110-240 Vac power supply, dual 1000BASE-SX Port 5/6 SFP transceivers.
